# Practice: describing data {#sec-practice-describing}

::: {.callout-tip appearance="minimal"}
The code cells on this page run **in your browser**: edit them and press

few seconds while R loads.
:::

## Explore

This cell is pre-filled. Run it, then change `eruptions` to `waiting` and run
it again.

```{webr}
summary(faithful$eruptions)
```

Plots work too. Try changing `binwidth`.

```{webr}
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(faithful, aes(x = eruptions)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.25, fill = "steelblue", colour = "white") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Exercises

**Exercise 1.** Compute the mean waiting time (in minutes) between eruptions.

```{webr}
#| exercise: ex_mean_wait
mean(______)
```

::: {.hint exercise="ex_mean_wait"}
The waiting times are in the `waiting` column of the `faithful` data frame.
Use `$` to pick a column.
:::

::: {.solution exercise="ex_mean_wait"}
```r
mean(faithful$waiting)
```
:::

```{webr}
#| exercise: ex_mean_wait
#| check: true
if (isTRUE(all.equal(.result, mean(faithful$waiting)))) {
  list(correct = TRUE, message = "Correct! About 71 minutes on average.")
} else {
  list(correct = FALSE, message = "Not quite: did you use the waiting column?")
}
```

**Exercise 2.** The median is *resistant* to extreme values. Compute the
median eruption duration and compare it with the mean from
@sec-describing-data.

```{webr}
#| exercise: ex_median_eruptions
______(faithful$eruptions)
```

::: {.solution exercise="ex_median_eruptions"}
```r
median(faithful$eruptions)
```
:::

```{webr}
#| exercise: ex_median_eruptions
#| check: true
if (isTRUE(all.equal(.result, median(faithful$eruptions)))) {
  list(correct = TRUE, message = "Right: 4 minutes, larger than the mean of about 3.49.")
} else {
  list(correct = FALSE, message = "Try the median() function.")
}
```
